verdict.rationale: The only documented sign-in method is magic-link email, and nothing shows SSO/SAML, an enterprise identity provider, or cloud-platform authentication such as an IAM-backed provider. The bring-your-own-key presets for model providers like OpenRouter or Groq are an adjacent model-routing feature, not enterprise or cloud-platform identity authentication, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can authenticate through an enterprise identity or cloud platform for compliance and scalability
